title: Per-direction queue-depth row overflows the 300px QoS panel by ~130-160px — renders un-clipped over the map
evidence: Panel width: `QOS_PANEL_W :: 300` (line 36); plate: `return {f32(rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X)), ..., f32(rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_W)), ...}` (line 54). Row start: `qdx := QOS_PANEL_X + 10 + i32(rl.MeasureTextEx(app.view.font, cstring(raw_data(label_c)), 14, 1).x) + 8` with label `fmt.tprintf("queue depth (bound %d):", bound)` (21 glyphs @ 14px ≈ 130-160px → qdx ≈ 170-200). The diff's new loop: `for dir in 0..<pp.PORT_DIR_COUNT { draw_text(app, dirs[dir], qdx, qd_y + 3, 14, p.ink_soft_text); qdx += 30; for lane in 0..<3 { ... qdx += 34 } qdx += 10 }` = 2 × 142 = 284px of columns → row ends ≈ x 440-472 vs the plate edge at 312. Old row was 3 × 34 = 102px (ended ≈ 272-292 — inside). Every other row fits by construction: `w := (rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_W) - rnd.hud(&app.view, 16) - rnd.hud(&app.view, 4) * (n - 1)) / n` (line 96). No scissor/clip exists in qos_panel.odin or view.odin (grep: only world-grid clipping).
detail: The S5 per-direction readout (this PR's own deliverable) paints its fwd tail + the entire rev group past the plate border, over live gameplay. T2 can't catch it — the row needs a selected pipe, and S5 logged zero golden drift.
recommended_fix: Stack the two direction groups on two sub-rows inside the panel (or compact: drop the fwd/rev captions and halve the column pitch), keeping the row within QOS_PANEL_W like the preset-row math.

title: NOC QUEUE row label `R%d>%d` outgrew the 52px gutter the old `P%d` label fit — collides with the E-lane column once node ids hit two digits
evidence: New label: `draw_mono_c(v, fmt.tprintf("R%d>%d", pr.router, pr.peer), px + 6, ty, NOC_SIZE_BODY, NOC_TXT_DIM)` at `NOC_SIZE_BODY :: 18` (line 344); first lane column starts at a fixed `bx := px + 52 + i32(lane) * 104`. The diff removed the old form `draw_mono_c(v, fmt.tprintf("P%d", p.pipe), px + 6, ty, NOC_SIZE_BODY, NOC_TXT_DIM)` whose worst case ("P123", 4 glyphs ≈ 36-43px) fit the gutter. Node ids are append-only E11 slots: any router or peer id ≥ 10 makes the label 5-6 glyphs ≈ 45-65px at mono advance, ending past px+52 into the lane letter.
detail: The re-key widened the row's identity label ~2× while the lane-grid x-offsets are unchanged — on growing maps (ids ≥ 10 are routine) the label overlaps the Express lane letter/bar. Same fixed-layout-overflow class as the QoS panel row.
recommended_fix: Widen the lane-grid offset for the QUEUE section (e.g. bx := px + 68) or render the pair label at NOC_SIZE_LABEL / compact form ("10>20") so the gutter holds 6 glyphs.
